headline: Pakistan lost 3-2 to India in their SAFF Championship opener at the National Stadium in Dhaka on Thursday after scoring twice in stoppage time, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Stoppage time mein 2 goal ke bawajood Pakistan haar gaya

caption:
SAFF Championship mein Pakistan ko India se 3-2 se shikast!
Dawn ke mutabiq Thursday ko Dhaka ke National Stadium mein half-time tak 3-0 se peeche rehne ke baad Pakistan ne stoppage time mein Najeebullah aur Alamgir ke goals se score 3-2 kar diya. Pakistan ka agla match Sunday, 8 November ko Maldives se hai.
Kya Pakistan agle round mein pohanch payega? Comment mein batayein 👇
